display.purpose: Press Start 2P is the only face — headings, body, labels, data. Single weight; 8–11px for dense UI, 8/16px for crisp sizes.

shadows.name: shadow-btn
shadows.purpose: Buttons and thumbs; removed while pressed.

shadows.name: shadow-key
shadows.purpose: Keyboard keys and knobs; removed on live press.

motion.name: press
motion.value: translateY + shadow removal, no easing curve
motion.purpose: Physical pixel press on every control.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Chunky pixel CTA with a hard drop shadow that presses down.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: rgba(220,138,120,.5); color: #4c4f69; border: 3px solid #dce0e8; box-shadow: 0 4px 0 0 #9ca0b0; font-family: 'Press Start 2P', monospace; font-weight: 400; font-size: 16px; padding: 12px 20px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.05); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(4px); box-shadow: none; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px dashed #8839ef; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #bcc0cc; color: #4c4f69; border: 3px solid #dce0e8; box-shadow: 0 4px 0 0 #9ca0b0; font-family: 'Press Start 2P', monospace; font-weight: 400; font-size: 16px; padding: 12px 20px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: translateY(4px); box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Panel
components.description: Base panel with crust border and flat offset depth.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: #eff1f5; border: 3px solid #dce0e8; box-shadow: 0 4px 0 0 #ccd0da; padding: 16px; color: #4c4f69; } .ds-panel-title { font-family: 'Press Start 2P', monospace; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .02em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #5c5f77; margin: 0 0 8px; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Tiny status chip for device/demo/busy state.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; border: 2px solid #dce0e8; background: #eff1f5; color: #4c4f69; padding: 2px 6px; font-family: 'Press Start 2P', monospace; font-weight: 400; font-size: 12px; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Mantle-well text field with lavender focus border.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #e6e9ef; border: 3px solid #dce0e8; color: #4c4f69; caret-color: #4c4f69; font-family: 'Press Start 2P', monospace; font-weight: 400; padding: 6px 8px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #5c5f77; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #7287fd; }

components.name: Pixel Slider
components.description: Square-track range control with a pressing square thumb.
components.css: .ds-slider { -webkit-appearance: none; appearance: none; height: 24px; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; } .ds-slider::-webkit-slider-runnable-track { height: 12px; background: #bcc0cc; border: 3px solid #dce0e8; } .ds-slider::-webkit-slider-thumb { -webkit-appearance: none; width: 20px; height: 20px; margin-top: -7px; background: #dc8a78; border: 3px solid #dce0e8; box-shadow: 0 3px 0 0 #9ca0b0; } .ds-slider:active::-webkit-slider-thumb { transform: translateY(3px); box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Keyboard Key
components.description: Signature pixel key with physical + assigned legend and press physics.
components.css: .ds-key { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 2px; background: #ccd0da; border: 3px solid #dce0e8; box-shadow: 0 3px 0 0 #9ca0b0; color: #4c4f69; cursor: pointer; } .ds-key:active { transform: translateY(2px); box-shadow: none; } .ds-key-phys { font-family: 'Press Start 2P', monospace; font-weight: 400; font-size: 8px; opacity: .6; } .ds-key-bind { font-family: 'Press Start 2P', monospace; font-size: 8px; }

narrative.northStar: A keyboard configurator that feels like petting a cat
narrative.overview: Mewxus wraps a hall-effect keyboard's raw USB protocol in a pastel pixel world. Everything is square, chunky, and pressed-like: 3px crust borders instead of radius, hard 4px offset shadows instead of blur, checker and dither fields instead of gradients. The Catppuccin Latte palette supplies every color. Cuteness lives in the chrome and the mascot; it never lives in the controls.
keyCharacteristics: Zero border-radius anywhere; square corners are the world's signature
Hard offset shadows (no blur) as the only depth system
Press Start 2P everywhere — headings, body, labels, data; the only face in the system
State fills are tints, not solid accents (readability floor >= 4.5:1)
Painted key colors are displayed blended 45% toward base; the device keeps the true RGB

rules.name: The Tint State Rule
rules.body: Active/selected/pressed fills are accent tints (25–50% over base) with text ink — never solid accent fills with light text.

rules.name: The No-Pure-Black Rule
rules.body: No #000 or #fff anywhere; darkest ink is #4c4f69, lightest ground #eff1f5.

rules.name: The Bitmap Sizes Rule
rules.body: 8px and 16px are crisp; 10–11px for dense UI is accepted. Never below 8px, never synthetic bold or italic.

rules.name: The Press-Down Rule
rules.body: Every pressable element moves down and loses its shadow when active — never scale, never blur.

dos: Do express every state as an accent tint at 25–50% with text ink.
Do keep depth as hard offset shadows that disappear on press.
Do blend displayed key paints toward base (45%) so labels stay legible.
donts: Don't use blurred shadows, gradients, or glass.
Don't put light text on mid-tone accent fills.
Don't use emoji or unicode glyphs as icons; draw pixel SVGs.
